services.desc: A 21-acre park overlooking Lakewood Gulch, visitors can enjoy the sunshine, take in a sunset, or explore the playground. The city of Lakewood’s Sunset park is getting a facelift. The existing safety surfacing at the playground is being replaced with ADA compliant engineered wood fiber play surfacing. The access ramp into the play pit will be replaced with a fully ADA compliant access ramp. Along with these accessibility and maintenance upgrades, the two damaged spring toys are being replaced with new, safe and updated editions.
